reviews.title: Great extenders!
reviews.comment: Made routing the power to my new video card easy and looks really nice!
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: I'm using this for a desktop GPU connected to an ADT-UT3G egpu and atx psu. The goal was to prevent wear to the gpu due to disconnecting the 8 pin pci-e connector daily from the GPU. I've only had this a couple days but it has worked without a hitch and its much easier to disconnect the psu and i just leave the extension connected to the gpu to prevent wear on the connector. Its much easier to disconnect from these adapters than natively on the egpu.
reviews.author: Robert E.

reviews.title: Worked OK to extend cable
reviews.comment: Replaced a 6-pin card with an 8-pin card.  The connector at the end of the cable was 6-pin, but the connector in the middle of the cable was 6+2.  Used this to extend the 6+2 connector(s) to the card. Seems to be high quality, and everything is working OK.
reviews.author: G Hammer

reviews.title: Must have for those short OEM cables.
reviews.comment: Well made cable that worked. Used this on a Nvidia 1070 w/ no issue.
reviews.author: Fuquar

reviews.title: Almost there...
reviews.comment: To start off, the materials are VERY sturdy. I was very impressed with how they're put together. Everything about these cables seems like they will withstand normal wear and tear very well. They provide what's needed in terms of using much less space than the generic cabling that comes with a power supply. They also clip in very easily while still providing a solid connection. I'm most impressed with how little space they use. They provided me with just the right amount of extra length without having to be looped around in my tower. I would highly recommend these if you're looking for that bit of extra length without taking up more space than needed.
reviews.author: Bethany Budge
